title: 5 takeaways as Red Sox overcome 5 deficits to outlast White Sox in 13 innings for 8th straight victory
author: Trevor Hass
bullets: The Boston Red Sox defeated the Chicago White Sox 12-11 in 13 innings for their eighth consecutive victory.
Caleb Durbin's RBI single scored Nick Sogard to win the game after the Red Sox overcame five deficits.
The game featured 17 pitchers, 447 pitches, and lasted nearly five hours at Fenway Park.

title: Patriots Stock Watch 1.0: Who is rising, falling on depth chart after 11 days of practice?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: A.J. Brown and Dre'Mont Jones impress at Patriots training camp, strengthening their positions on the roster.
Kyle Williams and Caleb Lomu experience setbacks at camp, affecting their standing for the upcoming season.
Terrell Jennings emerges as a strong contender for the third running back spot in Patriots depth chart.

title: Could Franklin Arias join Red Sox before end of 2026 season?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Franklin Arias is the No. 2 prospect in baseball, batting .326 with 12 RBI in 10 Triple-A games.
Arias, 20, was recently promoted to Triple-A Worcester and shows potential for a major league call-up.
Red Sox evaluating Arias' development for a potential 2026 season call-up amid injuries to key players.

title: Police search for person they say broke into Jamaica Plain apartment, tried to pull blanket off sleeping victim
author: Audrey Cooney
bullets: Boston police seek aid identifying a suspect in a Jamaica Plain apartment break-in on Aug. 5.
Suspect reportedly climbed through a window and attempted to remove a blanket from a sleeping victim.
Suspect described as Black, late teens or early 20s, slim build; last seen in a white t-shirt and black and white cap.

title: Why did this part break so quickly on my 2023 pickup?
author: John Paul
bullets: A 2023 Ford Maverick owner reported broken front sway bar links with only 22,000 miles driven.
The mechanic attributed the issue to lack of quality parts; repairs may be covered under warranty.
Consider aftermarket sway bar links with greaseable ends for potentially extended part life.

title: 5 takeaways from Jaylen Brown’s introductory press conference with 76ers
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Jaylen Brown expressed mixed emotions about being traded from the Celtics to the 76ers, describing it as a painful process.
Brown acknowledged he hasn't communicated with Jayson Tatum since the trade, emphasizing respect but little personal relationship.
Brown spoke positively about his decade in Boston, highlighting his development and the city's impact on his life and career.

title: 4 injured in Boston school bus rollover, police say
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Four adults injured in a school bus rollover in Mattapan, Boston, Thursday afternoon; no children were on the bus.
The rollover occurred near 1000 Harvard St.; authorities responded shortly before 1:10 p.m.
Victims sustained non-life-threatening injuries and were taken to a local hospital; the cause of the accident is unclear.

title: Drake Maye struggled during two-minute drill, and other takeaways from Day 11 of Patriots training camp
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Drake Maye threw two interceptions during the two-minute drill at Patriots training camp on Thursday.
Marcus Bryant took first-team reps at left tackle as Will Campbell was limited in practice.
Rookie linebacker Gabe Jacas participated with the first team as part of his return to play plan.

title: A beloved Cape Cod restaurant is closing after 21 years
author: Kristi Palma
bullets: Chach Restaurant in Provincetown, owned by Viola Briseño and Sharon Bowes, will close on November 2 after 21 years.
The closure announcement on Facebook led to nearly 150 comments from patrons expressing gratitude and sorrow.
Briseño and Bowes handled all cooking at the 52-seat restaurant, known for its upscale comfort food made from scratch.

title: The best movies on Netflix right now (August 2026)
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: Netflix's August 2026 movie list includes 'Clueless,' featuring Alicia Silverstone, Paul Rudd, and Stacey Dash.
Bo Burnham's directorial debut 'Eighth Grade' offers a heartfelt look at middle school life, starring Elsie Fisher.
Jack Nicholson and Diane Keaton star in 'Something’s Gotta Give,' a romantic comedy about unexpected love.
